follow Beijing time in real time:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Pricing badge**: `standard` (before 2026-08-17) / `peak` / `off-peak`, judged live in Beijing ti"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"me
- **Countdown**: time remaining until the next pricing switch, ticking every second — plan your u"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"sage ahead
- **Balance**: live balance from the official `/user/balance` endpoint (granted / topped-"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"up split)

- **`?` icon**: opens the official pricing page <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"/pricing/>

option is an "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"escape hatch only — it lands in a config file in plaintext, so **avoid it**.
`baseUrl` must be https"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"; plaintext http is rejected outright (it would put the key on
the wire).
- **Balance endpoint**: `/"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"query-tide` serves your account balance, so readers are checked.
